subject: Makefile respect user's REDIS_CFLAGS and OPT (#13073)
reason: The change is confined to src/Makefile: it relocates default optimization flags (-flto, -fno-omit-frame-pointer) from REDIS_CFLAGS into the OPTIMIZATION variable and adds $(OPT) to FINAL_LDFLAGS so user-provided REDIS_CFLAGS and OPT are honored. It is purely a build/CI flag-handling change with no runtime behaviour change to the server, commands, replication, persistence, or tools, so there is no changed code path a fuzzer scenario could reach.
